# LJ Link

> Free, open-source app (Eclipse Public License 2.0) for lighting jockeys (LJs) in clubs, at festivals and at events. It shows every DJ deck live – waveforms, position, hot cues, memory cues, loops, beat grid, BPM and key – from Pioneer DJ players (Pro DJ Link) and Denon DJ players (StageLinQ), and sends the BPM to grandMA2 and grandMA3 (and, as a beta, to a Wolfmix over Ableton Link or every beat over OS2L), so no tap tempo is needed. macOS and Windows.

- Passive: it only listens and sends no commands to the DJ gear. One exception, off by default: the optional Ableton Link output leads the tempo of a Link session, so Link programs that join it (including DJ software such as Traktor) follow LJ Link's tempo. No cloud, no telemetry.
- Pioneer and Denon at the same time; devices are added and removed automatically.
- Any tablet, phone or second screen in the network can open the same view.
- Suite chat (alpha, from 1.7.11): one chat room for LJ Link and the other suite programs in the same network (for example VJ-Link and LJL Link), without a server, with an EMERGENCY pop-up. Only on the computer running LJ Link, can be switched off, stays in the local network (multicast, TTL 1), chat texts are never logged. Not tested between two computers or on Windows yet. Wiki: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-chat.html
- Serato DJ Pro with LJL Link (alpha, from LJ Link 1.7.11): Serato DJ Pro has no public interface that LJ Link could use for decks, waveforms and position. LJL Link – LJ LAN Link (https://github.com/skyplayser/LJL-Link, website https://skyplayser.github.io/LJL-Link/) is a separate small, free and open-source Mac app for users of Serato DJ Pro. The DJ starts it from the club's USB stick, nothing is installed. It passively reads Serato's log file, the loaded track and the time display in Serato's window, and sends deck, length, BPM, key, three-band waveforms and position over the local network to LJ Link in the booth; track names only with the DJ's OK. It never controls Serato and never touches controllers or MIDI. It joins the suite chat with LJ Link and VJ-Link (not encrypted, every device in the network can read along; EMERGENCY is not an alarm or safety system). Needs macOS 14 or newer and LJ Link 1.7.11 or newer; tested locally on one Mac with Serato DJ Pro 5.0, not yet in a club. Independent project, not affiliated with Serato. Download: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJL-Link/#download. Guide: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-ljl-link.html
- Older gear too, not only the CDJ-3000: every Pioneer player with a LINK port sends its tempo over Pro DJ Link. CDJ-2000NXS, CDJ-900NXS, XDJ-1000, XDJ-700 and DJM-900NXS are expected to work (not tested yet).
- Not supported yet: titles, waveforms and beat grid from the CDJ-3000X (seen in a user report; tempo, BPM, time and play state do arrive), most likely because of its newer OneLibrary format. The OPUS-QUAD uses the same format and is not tested. The XDJ-AZ gave titles, BPM, time and waveforms in a user report once Pro DJ Link was switched on in its settings (then only 2 decks; alpha, not checked by us); in its 4-deck mode no data arrived so far. From version 1.7.10 the DJM-A9 is detected as mixer (alpha); its tempo and master only if it sends a mixer status LJ Link can read. Do not run rekordbox or ShowKontrol on the same computer as LJ Link.
- Works with (in our own setups, no formal test protocol): CDJ-3000, CDJ-2000NXS2, DJM-2000NXS, Denon Prime 4+, grandMA2 onPC. grandMA3 follows the manual and is not yet tried on a desk; Daslight works, over Ableton Link (recommended) or an OSC tap on every beat for its BPM Tap button; the Wolfmix is beta (tried on a W1; Ableton Link recommended, OS2L via WTOOLS possible); ChamSys MagicQ (an OSC tap on every beat, for Tap to Time) is an untested alpha. Serato DJ Pro works on the same computer without play position; over the network, the separate Mac app LJL Link (https://github.com/skyplayser/LJL-Link, alpha, not tested in a real club yet) sends track, length, BPM, key, waveforms and position from the DJ's Mac to LJ Link 1.7.11 or newer in the booth; needs macOS 14 or newer; tested with Serato DJ Pro 5.0 (https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-ljl-link.html). Ableton Link gives a session tempo; leading a Link session with the tempo, beats and bars of a Pioneer or Denon deck works with Daslight. Traktor, VirtualDJ and rekordbox are planned. Users are invited to report their setup with the Hardware report issue template.
- Free and without warranty: software, network and devices can fail; test the setup before the show and keep a fallback ready (for example tap tempo on the desk).
- LJ Link is an independent project. It is not an official product of, and is not endorsed by, any maker of DJ, lighting or music hardware or software. All product names and trademarks mentioned in LJ Link and its documentation belong to their respective owners and are used only to describe compatibility. Ableton and Link are trademarks of Ableton AG. LJ Link is not related to the LightJockey software by Martin.

## Guides

- [LJ Link: BPM from Pioneer CDJs to grandMA](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/pioneer-bpm-grandma.html): send the tempo of Pioneer CDJs over Pro DJ Link to a grandMA2 (Telnet) or grandMA3 (OSC) speed master, compared with tap tempo, MIDI clock and Beat Link Trigger. German: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/de/pioneer-bpm-grandma.html
- [Waveforms for the lightjockey](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/lightjockey-waveforms.html): CDJ and Denon waveforms live at the light desk, on a laptop or tablet.
- [LJ Link: Denon StageLinQ for lighting](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/denon-stagelinq-lighting.html): Prime 4+, Prime 4, Prime Go and SC6000 with waveforms, faders and BPM to grandMA.

## Wiki

- [Wiki overview](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki.html): every use case step by step, with an honest status for every device. German: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/de/wiki.html
- [Network setups compared](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-network-setups.html): direct cable, switch, router with DHCP, DJM LINK sockets, Wi-Fi only, two networks.
- [Light desks](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-lighting-desks.html): grandMA2 (stable), grandMA3 (beta), ChamSys MagicQ (alpha), Wolfmix (beta: Ableton Link or OS2L), Daslight (works: Ableton Link or OSC tap), own OSC target, dot2.
- [Use cases](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-use-cases.html): club with CDJs and grandMA2, onPC on one laptop, Pioneer and Denon in one night, mobile with Wolfmix, Serato, tablet, two networks, livestream.
- [LJL Link for Serato DJ Pro](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-ljl-link.html): the separate Mac app LJL Link (alpha) – preparing the USB stick with club.json, setting up, track names only with the DJ's permission, macOS permissions, suite chat, limits and problems. German: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/de/wiki-ljl-link.html
- [Ableton Link](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-ableton-link.html): take the tempo of a Link session, or lead it with the DJ tempo, beats and bars (works with Daslight).
- [Troubleshooting](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-troubleshooting.html): by symptom.
- [Known issues](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-known-issues.html): known bugs and how to fix them.
